_README: Started by init.py from Food Fight (NTSC) (Atari) (1987) (E64A5CDE).a78.
Every human judgement about this ROM lives in this file; the
generated listings are disposable, so renaming is free.
What to do next, roughly in order:
Read the coverage it reports. Low coverage is normal at
first and is the number you are trying to move.
2. Every unresolved indirect jump it reports is a hole. Add the
target to `entries`, or the pointer pair to `ram_vectors` if
the handler is installed into RAM.
Finds the sound code and the tables feeding it.
4. Name things in `labels` as soon as you know what they are.
See docs/method.md for the working order and docs/pitfalls.md for
the traps that each cost real time.

comments.rom:B3B3: copies the shadow palette $1FC3-$1FE1 to P0C1-P7C3, three bytes at a time, skipping every fourth register (stride 4). Called from the $B448 stage of the NMI chain and from rom:FBE4

headers.rom:F081:
shadow-palette start values, not level configuration (corrected
2026-11-08, see docs/DISCOVERY.md): sub_B3A7 copies 32 bytes, $F081-$F0A0,
to $1FC3. Every fourth byte is the register slot sub_B3B3 skips
headers.rom:F0C1:
DLL template, not sprite character data (corrected 2026-11-08, see
docs/DISCOVERY.md): sub_B22F copies $F0C1-$F0F9 (57 bytes, 19 three-byte
entries) to $1F8A, and sub_B23B/sub_B250 point DPPH/DPPL there. Four
entries carry the DLI bit ($89, $CF, $87, $8F), as many as the stages of
the $0040 NMI chain; five zones share the list at $1CFA
headers.rom:9DF1:
stick direction table, not a debounce mask (corrected 2026-11-08, see
docs/DISCOVERY.md): 16 bytes indexed by the SWCHA nibble at rom:B6EC, the
result to ram_00FA. 0-7 clockwise from up, 8 for no direction or an
impossible pair
headers.rom:B87C:
sound pointer tables, not music data (corrected 2026-11-08, see
docs/DISCOVERY.md): four tables of 33. $B87C/$B89D are the low/high bytes
of each sound's note stream ($F6A6-$FB5C, read at rom:B7B5 and rom:B807);
$B8BE/$B8DF those of its volume envelope ($F722-$FB1F, rom:B85B, written
to AUDV at rom:B86F)
